messages:
maria: Quick sync 1 UmbraTech POC. They're migrating from RivalAPI; main asks are exact streaming termination, function-call field shapes, and empty vs null completions. They want hosted POC with a pricing ask for ~500k tok/mo. Can eng confirm approach and risks?
kevin: We can add a per-tenant compat shim. Key risk: detokenization differs (unicode escapes) which can cause their validators to fail. Also, streaming termination bytes must match exactly.
sophia: Implementing a compat_mode toggle: rival_v1. Behavior: 1) strip internal meta frames, 2) re-encode SSE events matching RivalAPI (including final `data: [DONE]

`), 3) map empty-string->null for completions if flagged. Ops impact minimal for POC.
alex-security: They also want 14-day audit exports and logs pinned to us-west. BYOK? they asked.
sophia: For POC we can pin logs and retention; BYOK is feasible but will need security review. We'll offer masked export with PII redaction.
maria: Pricing note: they requested 50% off for 3 months. Sales proposed 40% + case study. Kevin: any perf regressions?
kevin: Small CPU overhead for re-encoding streams. We'll run perf regression and include eng credits for shim work. Dedicated reserved capacity only if they need hard 99p SLO.
sam-sales: Customer prefers hosted POC. Will push for 40% + eng credits and a short case study clause.
maria: Action items: Kevin prototype shim by Tue, Sophia produce ops + sec doc, Alex produce SOC2/BYOK Q&A. Demo Wed 10am PT. Keep notes here.
